fusions.name: Pounce of Nine Tails
fusions.desc: Springs you at an enemy up to 5 tiles away and lashes 9 tails out in a fan; each deals 2 damage, with a 15% chance to leave its target [Bleeding] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Wound Scent
fusions.desc: Rakes an enemy up to 5 tiles away, which deals 8 damage, up to 1.5 times that at full reach. It needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up.

fusions.name: Padded Fall
fusions.desc: Veils you for 6 seconds: enemies notice you 60% later and you move 17% faster. Attacking breaks the veil.

fusions.name: Raised Hackles
fusions.desc: Every time you avoid a blow, a stack builds on you, up to 4. When you reach 4, they all spend at once: a blow strikes the nearest enemy within 8 tiles for 27% of your weapon damage per stack (109% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
